prompts: A woman in a red trench coat stands on a rainy city street at night, neon signs reflecting in puddles around her as she holds a black umbrella.
Cars and buses stream through a busy intersection in the rain, headlights streaking across wet asphalt, traffic lights cycling from green to red.
The woman in the red trench coat walks toward the camera under her black umbrella, neon reflections shimmering in the puddles at her feet.
A golden retriever plays with a blue tennis ball on a sunny beach, kicking up sand near the shoreline.
Waves roll onto the empty shore, foam spreading across the wet sand as seagulls circle overhead.
The golden retriever runs back into frame carrying the blue tennis ball in its mouth, sand flying behind it.
An old fisherman in a yellow raincoat repairs a fishing net on a wooden dock, his weathered hands working the knots.
Fishing boats bob in the harbor beyond the dock, masts swaying gently against a gray overcast sky.
The old fisherman in the yellow raincoat lifts the repaired net and inspects it, standing on the same wooden dock.
A barista with a green apron pours latte art into a white ceramic cup at a wooden counter in a cozy cafe.
Customers chat at small tables by the cafe window, warm afternoon light falling across their coffee cups.
The barista in the green apron places the finished latte with its leaf-pattern art on the wooden counter.
A red vintage convertible is parked beside a desert highway, chrome trim gleaming under the midday sun.
Tumbleweeds drift across the empty desert highway, heat haze shimmering above the asphalt toward distant mesas.
The red vintage convertible drives down the desert highway, chrome gleaming as it passes the camera.
A ballet dancer in a white tutu practices pirouettes in a sunlit studio with a wall of mirrors.
Dust motes float through beams of sunlight falling across the empty studio floor, the mirror wall reflecting the tall windows.
The ballet dancer in the white tutu leaps across the studio, her reflection following in the wall of mirrors.
